name: NCAA D-III Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Rock Island, IL · host Augustana · Saukie Golf Course
headline: NCAA D-III Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: The deepest D-III men's region. Men: No. 1 Wartburg, No. 3 North Central (Ill.), No. 12 Chicago, No. 13 Washington (Mo.) and No. 19 Central (Iowa). Women: No. 6 Chicago, No. 8 Washington (Mo.) and No. 20 Wartburg. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn. · Women 6K 12:00 p.m. CT · Men 8K 1:00 p.m. CT
